name: Monstera
description:
Monstera Deliciosa

Bring a touch of the tropics into your home with the iconic Monstera Deliciosa, also known as the Swiss Cheese Plant. Famous for its large, glossy green leaves with distinctive splits and holes (fenestrations), this easy-care houseplant adds a dramatic and vibrant touch to any space.

The Monstera is a fast-growing climber that thrives in bright, indirect light. Regular watering and occasional misting will help it flourish. As your Monstera matures, its leaves develop increasingly intricate patterns, adding a unique living sculpture to your interior decor.

Key features:

  • Striking, fenestrated leaves
  • Easy to care for
  • Air-purifying qualities
  • Adds a lush, tropical feel

Order your Monstera Deliciosa today and enjoy the beauty and serenity of this remarkable plant.

name: The Planter by Rustic Roots
description:
A Story in Ceramic

Imagine a sun-drenched courtyard in the Italian countryside. The air is thick with the scent of jasmine and rosemary, and the gentle clinking of ceramic pots in the breeze. The Planter, with its hand-thrown curves and subtly rustic finish, embodies that same timeless elegance.

Crafted from the finest clay, each pot is a unique work of art, imbued with the artisan's touch. Let its earthy beauty elevate your favorite botanicals, transforming your home into a haven of natural sophistication.

name: African Fig
description:
A lush and sculptural plant with elegantly elongated, dark green leaves, the African Fig (Ficus cyathistipula) adds a touch of natural sophistication to any indoor space. This hardy and resilient plant is well-suited for indoor environments, requiring bright indirect light to thrive.

  • Approximately 5.5 to 6.5 feet in overall height, from bottom of pot to top leaf
  • Botanical name: Ficus cyathistipula
  • Native to tropical central and eastern Africa
  • Live, fully grown, healthy plant · Grown in the USA

Please note that plants are grown naturally and can vary in height ± 10%. If you're looking for a specific height, please reach out, and we'd be happy to help.

description:
Bring the tropics into your home with the magnificent Bird of Paradise (Strelitzia reginae). Known for its large, banana-like leaves and striking, bird-like flowers in outdoor conditions, this plant is a showstopper in any indoor setting. While it may not bloom indoors, the Bird of Paradise offers a dramatic, lush vibe that complements modern and classic interiors alike.

description:
The Jade Plant (Crassula ovata), also known as the Money Plant or Lucky Plant, is a classic indoor succulent admired for its thick, glossy, oval-shaped leaves and tree-like growth. Known for its resilience and low-maintenance nature, the Jade Plant can live for decades, even becoming a treasured family heirloom. With its unique, lush look, the Jade Plant adds charm and a touch of greenery to any home or office.

Native to South Africa and Mozambique
Live, fully grown, healthy plant · Grown in the USA

name: Pothos
description:
The Pothos (Epipremnum aureum), also known as Devil’s Ivy, is a hardy, easy-care plant that’s perfect for adding lush greenery to any indoor space. With its cascading vines and heart-shaped leaves that come in shades of green, yellow, and even variegated patterns, Pothos is an adaptable plant that thrives in a variety of conditions. Ideal for hanging planters, shelves, or training up a trellis, this plant brings life and beauty to any room with minimal effort.

Approximately 6 to 10 inches in height initially but can trail up to 10 feet or more
Botanical name: Epipremnum aureum
Native to Southeast Asia
Live, fully grown, healthy plant · Grown in the USA

Please note that plants are grown naturally and can vary in length and leaf patterns. If you’re looking for a specific size, please reach out, and we’d be happy to help.

description:
The Sansevieria (Sansevieria trifasciata), commonly known as the Snake Plant or Mother-in-Law’s Tongue, is a hardy and sculptural indoor plant with upright, sword-like leaves. Known for its striking, architectural look, this plant is perfect for adding a modern touch to any room. Sansevieria is also one of the best plants for improving indoor air quality, making it a beautiful and beneficial addition to homes and offices alike.

Imagine stepping into your own personal greenhouse, the air thick with the scent of fresh earth and vibrant greenery. As you tend to your leafy companions, misting them with a delicate, refreshing shower, your hand reaches for this elegant spray bottle. Crafted with a sleek, modern design, this bottle isn't just a tool, but a statement piece that seamlessly blends into your curated, sustainable lifestyle.
